	<ResortReportHeadline>Sunday Special!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like a glorious rinse and repeat of yesterday, with just an added touch of cooling breeze.&nbsp; The sky is clear, the current temperature is right on zero, heading for a top of 7 degrees and there's a light to moderate northerly breeze which is predicted to drop right off during the morning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow has had another decent freeze overnight, so it will be firm this morning and will soften on the sunny slopes as the day warms. The groomers should be good for carving turns first up, and some off piste zones will come into shape as the day progresses.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Road Runner will be spinning for First Tracks from 7:30am. Slap on the screen and follow the sun for fun turns all day.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
